verdicts.explanation: The paper says Li7N2I with 0.5% carbon nanotube composite was recently found experimentally to have 3.1 × 10-4 S/cm, citing ref. 39, so it is literature_cited. No temperature is given, and all secondary fields are null as the paper states them.

The Introduction calls Li6PS5X (X = Cl, Br) the typical argyrodite example and says it shows ionic conductivity as high as 1.1×10-3 S/cm with citation 23, so it is literature_cited. No temperature is stated, and the secondary fields are null.
